testcase.name: timeMillisToday maps HH-MM onto today at that local hour and minute
alarms are armed as wakeup alarms so they fire with the screen off
armed doses are persisted so they can be re-armed after a reboot
timeMillisToday falls back to 08-00 for malformed input instead of throwing
arming the same dose set twice does not stack duplicate alarms
each future dose registers one alarm at its exact trigger time
an empty dose list arms nothing and does not crash
a dose whose time has already passed today is not armed
